questions.text: Which sentence is the strongest specific evidence supporting this claim? An urban tree project showed how small planting decisions can improve public spaces.
options: The town museum displayed antique coins.
There are many interesting things to learn about the urban tree project.
The organizers were excited at first.
Volunteers compared sidewalk temperatures beneath young trees and on bare pavement.
questions.explanation: Specific observations provide stronger support than vague statements or unrelated information.

questions.text: Choose the combination that best shows cause and response: 'The original plot offered flowers for only a short period.' 'Gardeners added plants that bloom at different times.'
options: Because the original plot offered flowers for only a short period, gardeners added plants that bloom at different times.
The original plot offered flowers for only a short period. Gardeners added plants that bloom at different times.
The original plot offered flowers for only a short period, gardeners added plants that bloom at different times.
Because gardeners added plants that bloom at different times, the original plot offered flowers for only a short period.
questions.explanation: Because introduces the reason for the response without reversing the causal relationship or creating a comma splice.
